_meta.notes: SSOT for workspace MCP servers. Paths use ${workspaceFolder} (portable). Bun-native launch: command bun + script path (no run). Essential: bun-docs + cloudflare-docs. Cursor Cloudflare HTTP MCPs: Authorization Bearer ${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN} + envFile (.env). VS Code: bun run mcp:sync → .vscode/mcp.json with ${input:cloudflare-api-token} (HTTP has no envFile). Pre-commit regenerates .vscode/mcp.json when this file is staged. Cloudflare agent skills: bunx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/skills → .agents/skills/cloudflare*
